description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the CsvDataImportService in the OrangeHRM project. The class contains test cases for parsing CSV content related to employee data. It sets up CSV content variations with different edge cases and verifies correct parsing behavior, including handling of line breaks, special characters, and invalid CSV content.

classes.name: CsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of CsvDataImportService, particularly the parsing of CSV data into employee arrays, handling various edge cases like line breaks, special characters, and invalid formats.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes CsvDataImportService instance and sample header values before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNormalCSVContent
methods.description: Tests CSV parsing with normal CSV content containing employee data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithLineBreaksInCSV
methods.description: Tests CSV parsing when CSV data contains embedded line breaks within quoted fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithSpecialCharactersInCSV
methods.description: Tests CSV parsing with special characters, including carriage returns, tabs, and null bytes within data fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNonCSVContent
methods.description: Ensures that invalid non-CSV content triggers an exception indicating invalid CSV format.
